_comment: Sample produced-roadmaps input for backend.eval.run_nonobvious_recall_eval. Keys are '<CORRIDOR>:<employee_type>' slice ids matching backend/eval/hlp_nonobvious_baseline.json; values are lists of produced roadmaps (each a list of steps). This sample serves every non-obvious requirement in every slice, so every slice scores recall 1.0.

FR_NO:eu_national.title: Travel to Norway (no visa required for EEA nationals)
Register with the tax office — D-number / personnummer (Folkeregister)

FR_NO:non_eu_eea_national.title: Travel to Norway under EEA free movement
Register with the tax office — D-number / personnummer (Folkeregister)

FR_NO:non_eea_national.title: UDI residence permit granted before work starts
Register with the tax office — D-number / personnummer (Folkeregister)

ES_IE:eu_national.title: Obtain a PPSN (Personal Public Service Number)
Register the employment with Revenue (myAccount / RPN) to avoid emergency tax
Open an Irish bank account (proof of address + PPSN)

ES_IE:non_eu_passport_holder.title: Critical Skills Employment Permit application to DETE
Employment permit granted by DETE (labour authorisation, not immigration permission)
Long-stay 'D' Employment visa granted before travel (entry authorisation)
Register immigration permission — IRP card / Stamp 1 (within 90 days)
Obtain a PPSN (Personal Public Service Number)
Register the employment with Revenue (myAccount / RPN) to avoid emergency tax
Open an Irish bank account (proof of address + PPSN/IRP)
Register with a GP and arrange private health insurance
Stamp 4 eligibility reached after 21 months on the Critical Skills permit

NO_FR:norwegian_national.title: Preserve BankID before deregistration disables it
Norwegian tax residence does not end on the physical move
Applicable social-security legislation is FRANCE (not Norway)
The A1 certificate is issued by FRANCE (URSSAF), not by Norway
Norwegian employer must register with URSSAF (or delegate under Art. 21)
Register with CPAM for health cover and the carte vitale
Household-goods import with transfer-of-residence relief (franchise de déménagement)
